audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full-layer entry was built around an ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Ambessa has no such ability.
audit.why: Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E) and Public Execution (R). The matchup-defining cooldown is Public Execution at 130/115/100 — that is the level-6 all-in the content layer already describes.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Repeating Dashes' with Public Execution in tldr, winCon, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].t and dosFull[2].d, and rebuilt breakdown.cooldowns around the real ability names and numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Levels 4-5 row said 'trade around Repeating Dashes's cooldown' — a cooldown that does not exist, so there was nothing to track.
audit.why: The two cooldowns that actually gate her trades are Lacerate at 13s and Repudiation at 18s at rank 1. Both spent is Malphite's window; the content layer's 'levels 4-5 stay yours' only holds inside it.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why now names both real cooldowns and their rank-1 durations.

audit.whatIsWrong: Repudiation was never mentioned, and it is the single interaction that decides Malphite's trade pattern here.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ambessa gains a shield, braces, then slams — and if she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing, the slam deals increased damage. Malphite's whole trade is Thunderclap's empowered AoE autos, which is exactly the damage that feeds it. Holding autos through the brace turns her best button into a whiff.
audit.corrected: phases[1].why, dontsFull[0].d and content whys[1] now state the brace-empowerment and the hold-your-autos instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'Trade into her full combo' Don't had a body copy-pasted from a generic line and used male pronouns for Ambessa.
audit.why: The real mistake players make is autoing into the Repudiation brace, not the combo as a whole.

edits.after: Build armor — E-slow her autos, Q-kite her combo. Malphite wins the Public Execution cooldown windows.

edits.before: Build armor and E-slow her. Track Repeating Dashes before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Build armor and E-slow her. Track Public Execution before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: - Ambessa Repeating Dashes: matchup-defining — Her mobility. Q-kite around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ambessa Public Execution: 130s at rank 1 — she blinks to the far target and suppresses on arrival. - Repudiation: 18s, and damage blocked during the brace empowers the slam. - Lacerate: 13s. - Unstoppable Force: 130s.

edits.before: Passive shield resets between trades — space until it is back. Only take the trade when Ambessa's Repeating Dashes is down.
edits.after: Thunderclap turns your autos into armor-scaling AoE — but hold them through Repudiation's brace, blocked damage empowers her slam.

edits.after: Trade around Lacerate at 13s and Repudiation at 18s — with both spent, run the full pattern. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Public Execution's cooldown.

edits.after: Track Ambessa's Public Execution before you commit

edits.after: Thunderclap (W) turns your autos into armor-scaling AoE, but hold them through Repudiation's brace — blocked damage empowers her slam.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is a fabricated ability name and appeared throughout Malphite's full-layer Ambessa entry; her mobility is actually the passive Drakehound's Step, which has no cooldown to track, so I re-anchored the entry on Public Execution. The kit file flags Ambessa's W and R as 'grounding' — Riot's descriptions do not say either grounds, so I did not use it. It also flags Malphite's Q and E as 'grounding', which Riot's text contradicts; I never claimed Malphite can deny her dashes.
